card.name: Jack-o-Lantern
card.subject: A round orange pumpkin with vertical ribs, a short green stem on top and a carved face of two triangle eyes, a triangle nose and a wide zigzag grin.
card.hero_colors: orange pumpkin with a small green stem

card.name: Witch Hat
card.subject: A tall black pointed cone hat with a wide round flat brim and a band around the base of the cone with a square buckle in the front.
card.hero_colors: black hat with a yellow buckle on the band

card.name: Bat
card.subject: A real brown bat with wings spread wide and symmetrical, two pointed ears, a small furry body and tiny feet.
card.hero_colors: dark brown bat with small pink inner ears

card.name: Candlestick
card.subject: A round brass candlestick with a wide flat base, a straight stem, a cup holding one tall white candle, and a ring handle attached to the base.
card.hero_colors: golden brass with a white candle and a small orange flame

card.name: Cauldron
card.subject: A round black iron cauldron with a wide open top rim, two small side handles, three short legs standing on the ground, and green bubbling potion filling it.
card.hero_colors: black iron with glowing green potion and a small purple bubble

card.name: Candy Corn
card.subject: A single candy corn, a triangular sweet with a rounded tip, three stripes: white tip, orange middle and yellow base, sitting on its flat base.
card.hero_colors: yellow, orange and white candy with a small pink shine

card.name: Potion
card.subject: A round glass flask with a narrow neck and a cork stopper, filled with glowing purple liquid, standing on its flat bottom.
card.hero_colors: purple liquid in clear glass with a small green label-free cork

card.name: Haunted House
card.subject: A tall crooked mansion with a steep dark roof, a pointed tower on the left, a front door, four lit windows and a chimney, standing on a grassy hill.
card.hero_colors: grey-purple walls, dark roof, glowing yellow windows
card.backdrop_colors: clear bright blue sky with a pale full moon

card.name: Spooky Tree
card.subject: A big old tree with a thick trunk, a hollow knot and bare twisting branches that grow from the trunk, rooted in grass.
card.hero_colors: dark brown tree with a small orange leaf on one branch

card.name: Ghost Sheep
card.subject: The sheep, wearing a white bedsheet with two eye holes over its fleece, bumps into a carved pumpkin and the sheet slips sideways.
card.hero_colors: white sheet, grey face and legs, orange pumpkin
